ayahs.arabicText: حٰمٓۚ
ayahs.translation: Ha'. Mim.

ayahs.arabicText: تَنْزِیْلُ الْكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الْعَزِیْزِ الْحَكِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: This Book is a revelation from the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Behold, for those who believe there are (myriad) Signs in the heavens and the earth

ayahs.arabicText: وَ فِیْ خَلْقِكُمْ وَ مَا یَبُثُّ مِنْ دَآبَّةٍ اٰیٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ یُّوْقِنُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and in your own creation; and in the animals which He spreads out over the earth too there are Signs for those endowed with sure faith;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اخْتِلَافِ الَّیْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ وَ مَاۤ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مِنْ رِّزْقٍ فَاَحْیَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَ تَصْرِیْفِ الرِّیٰحِ اٰیٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ یَّعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and in the succession of night and day, and in the provision that Allah sends down from the sky wherewith He gives life to the earth after it had been lifeless, and in the change of the winds: (in all these) there are Signs for people who use reason.

ayahs.arabicText: تِلْكَ اٰیٰتُ اللّٰهِ نَتْلُوْهَا عَلَیْكَ بِالْحَقِّ١ۚ فَبِاَیِّ حَدِیْثٍۭ بَعْدَ اللّٰهِ وَ اٰیٰتِهٖ یُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: These are Allah's Signs that We rehearse to you in Truth. In what kind of discourse after Allah and His Signs will they, then, believe?

ayahs.arabicText: وَیْلٌ لِّكُلِّ اَفَّاكٍ اَثِیْمٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Woe to every guilty impostor

ayahs.arabicText: یَّسْمَعُ اٰیٰتِ اللّٰهِ تُتْلٰى عَلَیْهِ ثُمَّ یُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَاَنْ لَّمْ یَسْمَعْهَا١ۚ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: who hears Allah's Signs being rehearsed to him, and yet persists in his pride, as though he had not heard it. Announce to him, then, the tidings of a grievous chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِنَا شَیْئَا اِ۟تَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا١ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِیْنٌؕ
ayahs.translation: Whenever he comes to know anything of Our Signs, he makes them an object of jest. For such there awaits a humiliating chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: مِنْ وَّرَآئِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ١ۚ وَ لَا یُغْنِیْ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَسَبُوْا شَیْئًا وَّ لَا مَا اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اَوْلِیَآءَ١ۚ وَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِیْمٌؕ
ayahs.translation: Hell is behind them. Their worldly earnings shall not avail them, nor those whom they took as protectors instead of Allah. An awesome chastisement lies in store for them.

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذَا هُدًى١ۚ وَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِاٰیٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّنْ رِّجْزٍ اَلِیْمٌ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: This (Qur'an) is the true guidance. Those who deny the Signs of their Lord shall suffer the torment of a woeful scourge.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِیْ سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِیَ الْفُلْكُ فِیْهِ بِاَمْرِهٖ وَ لِتَبْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ وَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Allah it is Who has subjected the sea to you so that ships may sail upon it at His bidding and you may seek of His Bounty and give thanks to Him.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ سَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَّا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الْاَرْضِ جَمِیْعًا مِّنْهُ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ یَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He has subjected to you all that is in the heavens and the earth, all being from Him. Verily there are Signs in this for those who reflect.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ لِّلَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا یَغْفِرُوْا لِلَّذِیْنَ لَا یَرْجُوْنَ اَیَّامَ اللّٰهِ لِیَجْزِیَ قَوْمًۢا بِمَا كَانُوْا یَكْسِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), tell the believers to indulge those who have no fear of any evil days coming upon them from Allah so that Allah may Himself requite them for their deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهٖ١ۚ وَ مَنْ اَسَآءَ فَعَلَیْهَا١٘ ثُمَّ اِلٰى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Whoever acts righteously, does so to his own good; and whoever commits an evil will suffer its consequence. All of you will then be sent back to your Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا بَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَ الْكِتٰبَ وَ الْحُكْمَ وَ النُّبُوَّةَ وَ رَزَقْنٰهُمْ مِّنَ الطَّیِّبٰتِ وَ فَضَّلْنٰهُمْ عَلَى الْعٰلَمِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Indeed We endowed the Children of Israel with the Book and Wisdom and Prophethood, and provided them with good things as sustenance, and exalted them above the peoples of the whole world.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اٰتَیْنٰهُمْ بَیِّنٰتٍ مِّنَ الْاَمْرِ١ۚ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوْۤا اِلَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ١ۙ بَغْیًۢا بَیْنَهُمْ١ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ یَقْضِیْ بَیْنَهُمْ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ فِیْمَا كَانُوْا فِیْهِ یَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We gave them clear directions in matters pertaining to religion. Yet they differed among themselves (not out of ignorance but) after knowledge had come to them; and they did so out of the desire to commit excesses against one another. On the Day of Resurrection Allah will judge among them regarding what they had differed.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنٰكَ عَلٰى شَرِیْعَةٍ مِّنَ الْاَمْرِ فَاتَّبِعْهَا وَ لَا تَتَّبِعْ اَهْوَآءَ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And then We set you, (O Prophet), on a clear high road in religious matters. So follow that and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّهُمْ لَنْ یُّغْنُوْا عَنْكَ مِنَ اللّٰهِ شَیْئًا١ؕ وَ اِنَّ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلِیَآءُ بَعْضٍ١ۚ وَ اللّٰهُ وَلِیُّ الْمُتَّقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely they will be of no avail to you against Allah. Indeed the wrong-doers are friends of each other, whereas Allah is the friend of the God-fearing.

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذَا بَصَآئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَ هُدًى وَّ رَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ یُّوْقِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: These are the lights of discernment for people and guidance and mercy for those endowed with sure faith.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِیْنَ اجْتَرَحُوا السَّیِّاٰتِ اَنْ نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ١ۙ سَوَآءً مَّحْیَاهُمْ وَ مَمَاتُهُمْ١ؕ سَآءَ مَا یَحْكُمُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Do the evil-doers imagine that We shall make them equal to those who believe and do good, making their lives and deaths alike? How vile is their judgement!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَ لِتُجْزٰى كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَ هُمْ لَا یُظْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allah created the heavens and the earth in Truth that each person may be requited for his deeds. They shall not be wronged.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَرَءَیْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰهَهٗ هَوٰىهُ وَ اَضَلَّهُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى عِلْمٍ وَّ خَتَمَ عَلٰى سَمْعِهٖ وَ قَلْبِهٖ وَ جَعَلَ عَلٰى بَصَرِهٖ غِشٰوَةً١ؕ فَمَنْ یَّهْدِیْهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Did you ever consider the case of him who took his desire as his god, and then Allah caused him to go astray despite knowledge, and sealed his hearing and his heart, and cast a veil over his sight? Who, after Allah, can direct him to the Right Way? Will you not take heed?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا مَا هِیَ اِلَّا حَیَاتُنَا الدُّنْیَا نَمُوْتُ وَ نَحْیَا وَ مَا یُهْلِكُنَاۤ اِلَّا الدَّهْرُ١ۚ وَ مَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ١ۚ اِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا یَظُنُّوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They say: “There is no life other than our present worldly life: herein we live and we die, and it is only (the passage of) time that destroys us. Yet the fact is that they know nothing about this and are only conjecturing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا تُتْلٰى عَلَیْهِمْ اٰیٰتُنَا بَیِّنٰتٍ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ قَالُوا ائْتُوْا بِاٰبَآئِنَاۤ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And when Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, their only contention is: “Bring back to us our fathers if you are truthful.”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلِ اللّٰهُ یُحْیِیْكُمْ ثُمَّ یُمِیْتُكُمْ ثُمَّ یَجْمَعُكُمْ اِلٰى یَوْمِ الْقِیٰمَةِ لَا رَیْبَ فِیْهِ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Tell them, (O Prophet): “It is Allah Who gives you life and then causes you to die, and He it is Who will then bring all of you together on the Day of Resurrection, a Day regarding which there can be no doubt. Yet most people do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لِلّٰهِ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ؕ وَ یَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ یَوْمَئِذٍ یَّخْسَرُ الْمُبْطِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allah's is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and on the Day when the Hour (of Resurrection) shall come to pass, the followers of falsehood shall be in utter loss.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَرٰى كُلَّ اُمَّةٍ جَاثِیَةً١۫ كُلُّ اُمَّةٍ تُدْعٰۤى اِلٰى كِتٰبِهَا١ؕ اَلْیَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: On that Day you shall see every people fallen on their knees. Every people will be summoned to come forth and see its Record and will be told: “Today you shall be requited for your deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذَا كِتٰبُنَا یَنْطِقُ عَلَیْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ١ؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنْسِخُ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: This is Our Record which bears witness against you with truth; We used to record all what you did.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَمَّا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَیُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِیْ رَحْمَتِهٖ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِیْنُ
ayahs.translation: As for those who believe and act righteously, their Lord shall admit them to His Mercy. That indeed is the manifest triumph.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَمَّا الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا١۫ اَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ اٰیٰتِیْ تُتْلٰى عَلَیْكُمْ فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: But those who denied the Truth, they shall be told: “Were My Signs not rehearsed to you? But you waxed proud and became a guilty people.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا قِیْلَ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّ السَّاعَةُ لَا رَیْبَ فِیْهَا قُلْتُمْ مَّا نَدْرِیْ مَا السَّاعَةُ١ۙ اِنْ نَّظُنُّ اِلَّا ظَنًّا وَّ مَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَیْقِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And when it was said to them: “Surely Allah's promise is true, and there is no doubt regarding the Hour of Resurrection,” you were wont to say: “We do not know what the Hour (of Resurrection) is. We are simply making conjectures and are not at all certain.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ بَدَا لَهُمْ سَیِّاٰتُ مَا عَمِلُوْا وَ حَاقَ بِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ یَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (On that Day) the evil of their deeds will become apparent to them and what they had mocked at will encompass them,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قِیْلَ الْیَوْمَ نَنْسٰىكُمْ كَمَا نَسِیْتُمْ لِقَآءَ یَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَا وَ مَاْوٰىكُمُ النَّارُ وَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: and it will be said: “We will forget you today as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours. The Fire shall now be your abode, and you shall have none to come to your aid.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكُمْ بِاَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذْتُمْ اٰیٰتِ اللّٰهِ هُزُوًا وَّ غَرَّتْكُمُ الْحَیٰوةُ الدُّنْیَا١ۚ فَالْیَوْمَ لَا یُخْرَجُوْنَ مِنْهَا وَ لَا هُمْ یُسْتَعْتَبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: You reached this end because you made Allah's Signs an object of jest and the life of the world deluded you.” So they shall not be taken out of the Fire nor shall they be asked to make amends (and thus please their Lord).

ayahs.arabicText: فَلِلّٰهِ الْحَمْدُ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ رَبِّ الْاَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: So all praise be to Allah, the Lord of the heavens, the Lord of the earth, the Lord of the whole Universe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَهُ الْكِبْرِیَآءُ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١۪ وَ هُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الْحَكِیْمُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: His is the glory in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
